# Sources: third_party/bigquery_docs/reference/standard-sql/data-types.md (groupable types)
# third_party/bigquery_docs/reference/standard-sql/query-syntax.md (grouping sets)
# third_party/bigquery_docs/reference/standard-sql/aggregate_functions.md (GROUPING)
# third_party/bigquery_docs/reference/standard-sql/graph-sql-queries.md (GRAPH_TABLE)
# Graph elements group by identity, even when their visible properties are identical.
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (
  SELECT n, COUNT(*) AS c
  FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_graph.HiddenKeys MATCH (n:Person) RETURN n)
  GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((n), ())
)
=> "4"
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (
  SELECT n, COUNT(*) AS c
  FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_graph.HiddenKeys MATCH (n:Person) RETURN n)
  GROUP BY ROLLUP(n)
)
=> "4"
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (
  SELECT n, m, COUNT(*) AS c
  FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_graph.HiddenKeys MATCH (n:Person), (m:Person) RETURN n, m)
  GROUP BY CUBE(n, m)
)
=> "16"

# Included elements retain their properties; subtotal placeholders are NULL elements.
SELECT STRING_AGG(FORMAT('%d:%T:%d', g, n.id, c), ',' ORDER BY g, n.id) FROM (
  SELECT n, COUNT(*) AS c, GROUPING(n) AS g
  FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_graph.FinGraph MATCH (n:Person) RETURN n)
  GROUP BY ROLLUP(n)
)
=> "0:1:1,0:2:1,0:3:1,1:NULL:3"

# An input NULL element and a subtotal NULL element have distinct GROUPING flags.
SELECT STRING_AGG(FORMAT('%d:%T:%d', g, a.id, c), ',' ORDER BY g, a.id) FROM (
  SELECT a, COUNT(*) AS c, GROUPING(a) AS g
  FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_graph.TransferGraph
    MATCH (n:Person)
    OPTIONAL MATCH (n)-[:Owns]->(a:Account {is_blocked: TRUE})
    RETURN a)
  GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((a), ())
)
=> "0:NULL:2,0:16:1,1:NULL:3"

# GROUPING without grouping sets is zero, including for input NULL elements.
SELECT SUM(g) FROM (
  SELECT a, COUNT(*) AS c, GROUPING(a) AS g
  FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_graph.TransferGraph
    MATCH (n:Person)
    OPTIONAL MATCH (n)-[:Owns]->(a:Account {is_blocked: TRUE})
    RETURN a)
  GROUP BY a
)
=> "0"

# HAVING MAX/MIN aggregates take the per-grouping expansion path.
SELECT STRING_AGG(FORMAT('%d:%T:%d', g, n.id, last.id), ',' ORDER BY g, n.id) FROM (
  SELECT n, ANY_VALUE(n HAVING MAX n.id) AS last, GROUPING(n) AS g
  FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_graph.FinGraph MATCH (n:Person) RETURN n)
  GROUP BY ROLLUP(n)
)
=> "0:1:1,0:2:2,0:3:3,1:NULL:3"
SELECT STRING_AGG(FORMAT('%d:%T:%d', g, n.id, first.id), ',' ORDER BY g, n.id) FROM (
  SELECT n, ANY_VALUE(n HAVING MIN n.id) AS first, GROUPING(n) AS g
  FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_graph.FinGraph MATCH (n:Person) RETURN n)
  GROUP BY ROLLUP(n)
)
=> "0:1:1,0:2:2,0:3:3,1:NULL:1"

# Edge elements use identity keys too. Duplicate sets remain duplicate output groups.
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (
  SELECT e, COUNT(*) AS c
  FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_graph.FinGraph MATCH (:Person)-[e:Knows]->(:Person) RETURN e)
  GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((e), (e), ())
)
=> "9"

# Scalar keys and graph identity keys can participate in the same grouping product.
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (
  SELECT n, name, COUNT(*) AS c
  FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_graph.FinGraph MATCH (n:Person) RETURN n, n.name AS name)
  GROUP BY name, ROLLUP(n)
)
=> "6"

# The empty grouping still produces one row on empty input, with a NULL graph element.
SELECT FORMAT('%d:%d:%d', COUNT(n), SUM(c), SUM(g)) FROM (
  SELECT n, COUNT(*) AS c, GROUPING(n) AS g
  FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_graph.FinGraph MATCH (n:Person WHERE n.id = 999) RETURN n)
  GROUP BY ROLLUP(n)
)
=> "0:0:1"

# Composite keys and grouped item sets retain all identity components.
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (
  SELECT n, m, COUNT(*) AS c
  FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_graph.CompoundGraph MATCH (n:Compound), (m:Compound) RETURN n, m)
  GROUP BY ROLLUP((n, m))
)
=> "10"

# GRAPH_PATH is not groupable, so BigQuery rejects it in GROUP BY, DISTINCT, distinct aggregate
# calls and PARTITION BY, including inside an array or a struct.
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_graph.FinGraph MATCH gp = (a:Person)-[:Knows]->(b:Person) RETURN gp) GROUP BY gp
=> error:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT gp FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_graph.FinGraph MATCH gp = (a:Person)-[:Knows]->(b:Person) RETURN gp))
=> error:
SELECT n FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_graph.FinGraph MATCH gp = (a:Person)-[:Knows]->(b:Person) RETURN COUNT(DISTINCT gp) AS n)
=> error:
SELECT ARRAY_LENGTH(paths) FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_graph.FinGraph MATCH gp = (a:Person)-[:Knows]->(b:Person) RETURN ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT gp) AS paths)
=> error:
SELECT n FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_graph.FinGraph MATCH gp = (a:Person)-[:Knows]->(b:Person) RETURN gp NEXT RETURN COUNT(*) AS n GROUP BY gp)
=> error:
SELECT n FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_graph.FinGraph MATCH gp = (a:Person)-[:Knows]->(b:Person) WITH DISTINCT gp RETURN COUNT(*) AS n)
=> error:
SELECT MAX(n) FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_graph.FinGraph MATCH gp = (a:Person)-[:Knows]->(b:Person) RETURN COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY gp) AS n)
=> error:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_graph.FinGraph MATCH gp = (a:Person)-[:Knows]->(b:Person) RETURN [gp] AS paths) GROUP BY paths
=> error:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_graph.FinGraph MATCH gp = (a:Person)-[:Knows]->(b:Person) RETURN STRUCT(gp AS p) AS s) GROUP BY s
=> error:
